rules.statement: A co-owner who has been in possession of a land for a long period without interruption or disturbance is entitled to a share in the land, even if they do not have a clear title.
rules.supporting_quote: The said Podisira Fernando died leaving Alawattage Jemis Fernando, and per averment 5 of the Amended Plaint it is said the that Alawattage Jemis had conveyed Y-t share of the land to a third party, which has been possessed by the 4th Defendant.
